name: Pointage – Time clock
description: Staff clock in, take breaks and clock out from a pinned message or /pointage (works in the mobile app). Managers see team hours, fix days and export a monthly CSV. English, French, German and Italian, following each user's language. By ShiftPlugins (Smafe, Switzerland).

settings_schema.header: Type `/pointage enable` (or `/pointage activer`) in a channel to pin the clock buttons there. `/pointage` works in every channel. Each person sees the plugin in their own Mattermost language (English, French, German or Italian).

settings.help_text: Usernames (comma separated) who can see the whole team's hours, fix them and export them. System admins always can.
Private reminder to anyone still clocked in after this many hours. 0 = no reminder.
Beyond this, a clock-in counts as forgotten: the person must enter their end time, otherwise it counts 0 h until a manager fixes it.

settings.display_name: Members can fix their own hours
settings.help_text: Otherwise only managers can fix hours. Fixes are always marked in the export.
Time zone used for times and days (IANA format, e.g. Europe/Zurich).
